## Glyphling 1.1.1

Download `Glyphling-Setup-1.1.1.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position.

### Fixes
- **No more demo data in the real app.** With no media app playing, the music panel showed a sample song from the design demo instead of "Nothing playing". The app now starts in the empty state and only shows real tracks.
- The weather panel no longer shows a sample forecast when the forecast cannot be loaded (no connection): it shows "Weather not available" with dashes.
- The panel still does not redraw by itself when nothing is playing.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway"). Glyphling is not affiliated with Nothing.
